scripts.compose: node composer/make_bilingual.js --ts translations/pristine/zh-Hans.ts --out translations/working/zh-Hans.ts --all && node composer/make_model_display_bilingual.js --config composer/bilingual.config.json --in translations/pristine/model_display_translations.json --out translations/working/model_display_translations.json --lang zh-Hans
scripts.build:macos: npm run compose && mkdir -p translations/working && cp translations/working/zh-Hans.ts tools/zh-Hans.ts && cp translations/pristine/zh-Hant.ts tools/zh-Hant.ts && cp translations/pristine/ja_JP.ts tools/ja_JP.ts && cp translations/working/model_display_translations.json tools/model_display_translations.json && test -n "$CAVALRY_QT_PREFIX" && bash tools/build_translator_injector.sh dist/libCavalryTranslatorInjector.dylib || (echo 'set CAVALRY_QT_PREFIX first' && exit 1)
